title: 8 Home themes
text: Light, Dark, Nature, Minimal, Ocean, Sunset, Forest and Aurora backgrounds. Pick one in Home screen settings, next to the new Auto refresh dropdown (10 seconds up to once a day).

title: Live every 10 seconds
text: Delivery Tracker refreshes itself every 10 seconds. Home and + removed from the top bar. New switch to hide the Apps box on Home.

title: BoxUp Hub inside Chrome
text: Every new tab opens the Hub. Gmail and Google Sheets open signed in, with your bookmarks.
